evidence.summary: Exhaustive sweep over all 63488 finite FP16 values: 36556 elements exceed the 1e-6 absolute tolerance; max abs error is 1.91e-6 at x=31.78125. The kernel's rational-polynomial approximation of log(s) fails the contract's fixed 1e-6 absolute tolerance throughout the legal domain.

rationale: The correction term uses only a 4-coefficient Padé-style polynomial; such a short expansion may not achieve 1e-6 accuracy across the full argument range, especially where s is near 1 or 2.
